title: A new home for the playground and community
summary:
A themeable site, a consolidated community app directory, clearer subscription details, and model health numbers that know the difference between an outage and a 401.

The pollinations.ai frontend was replaced with the themeable site previously at hello.pollinations.ai, bringing its image playground, theme creator, app directory, community page, and docs together. A grayscale theme preset was added, and the contributors section gained a repository link.

App listings were consolidated into one date-sorted directory, with the 10 newest also shown in the README. Submission changes improved contributor credit and review, and fixed an issue-form error that prevented submissions from creating PRs. Three more community projects were added: BhaujAI, Asive AI, and Multi Image Generator.

Enter's tier view now uses structured subscription details, including refill countdowns and cancellation dates. The change also fixed tier date fields that prevented API documentation from generating.
